name: 48th Annual Casements Christmas Gala in Ormond Beach
host: the City of Ormond Beach news page
when_note: Friday, December 4, 5 to 9 PM; Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, noon to 5 PM
paras: The Casements Guild presents the 48th Annual Casements Christmas Gala, titled Home for the Holidays, over the weekend of December 4 to 6, 2026 at The Casements, the winter home of John D. Rockefeller in Ormond Beach.

Friday, December 4 runs from 5 to 9 PM, with the Christmas Tree Lighting and Santa's arrival at 6 PM in Rockefeller Gardens, holiday entertainment, food trucks, train rides, handmade crafts, the Gift Shoppe, the Tree Gallery, and a Gourmet Shop with ice cream.
Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, are a Holiday Open House from noon to 5 PM, with visits with Santa from noon to 3 PM, entertainment, handmade crafts, the Gift Shoppe and the Tree Gallery.
The city posted the announcement on November 25, 2026 and lists The Casements at (386) 610-0649 for more information, with a flyer available as a PDF.

name: 2nd Annual Wilkie Wonka Christmas Festival in Edgewater
paras: Strong4You.org lists the 2nd Annual Wilkie Wonka Christmas Festival and Community Giveaway at Hawks Park, 1108 S. Ridgewood Ave in Edgewater, on Sunday, December 13, 2026 from 11 AM to 5 PM.
The festival lists holiday photos with Santa, a petting zoo, free games, live local entertainment, bounce houses, face painting, food trucks and local vendors.
Every child who attends receives a Golden Ticket at the festival for a chance to win prizes donated by local businesses and sponsors, and winners are announced at 3 PM.
It is presented in partnership with the City of Edgewater, Wilkie's Pest Control and Strong4You.org, which also accepts donations through a PayPal link on the event page.
